pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


When you are new to the faith, you go through seasons. Some seasons are bright. You feel close to God. You feel His presence. You feel like you can take on the world. Other seasons are dark. You feel alone. You feel like God is far away. You feel like you are walking through fog.


Maybe you are in one of those dark seasons right now. Maybe you are new to the faith and you are already wondering, "Where is God? Why does He feel so distant? Does He even see me? Does He care?"


Here is something that will help you. God has always shown up for His people. From the very beginning, He has been a God who appears. He shows up in gardens. In tents. In fires. In storms. In whispers. He shows up for the scared. For the lonely. For the forgotten. For the weak.


This book is for you. It is a book of comfort. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at 30 moments in the Old Testament where God showed up. Real moments. Real people. Real comfort. And each one points to Jesus. Because Jesus is the ultimate way God shows up.


If you are in a dark season, this book is for you. If you are new to the faith and you are learning to trust God, this book is for you. If you need comfort, this book is for you. God shows up. He has always shown up. He is showing up right now.



The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will have a new confidence in the character of God. You will see that He is not a God who abandons His people. You will see that He is not a God who stays far away. You will see that He is a God who shows up. Again and again. In every season. In every story.


You will also have a new comfort in your own life. Because if God showed up for His people in the Old Testament, He will show up for you. He is the same yester...

pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the LORD God as he was walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and they hid from the LORD God among the trees of the garden." - Genesis 3:8 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Adam and Eve had sinned. They were ashamed. They hid. And God came walking. In the cool of the day. He did not come to punish them. He came to find them. He came to speak to them. He came close. This is the first time God shows up. And He shows up when they are hiding.


The Fulfillment


"But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us." - Romans 5:8


God did not wait for us to clean up. He came to us. He came close. He came while we were still sinners. The garden is a picture. The cross is the reality. He shows up when we hide.


Why It Matters For You


You might be hiding right now. You might be hiding from God because of shame. You might be hiding from God because of guilt. You might be hiding from God because you feel like you failed. But the story of the garden tells a different story. God does not come to punish you. He comes to find you. He comes to speak to you. He comes close. He shows up when you hide.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you are hiding from God right now. Then write this: "God comes to find me. He shows up when I hide."


The Prayer


God, I have been hiding. I have been ashamed. I have been afraid. But you come to find me. Thank you for showing up. Thank you for coming close. I am coming out. Amen.
pages.title: Day 1: He Shows Up When You Hide

pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he hurried from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground." - Genesis 18:2 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Three strangers came to Abraham's tent. One of them was God. Abraham did not know it at first. But he offered them food. He washed their feet. He made them a meal. And God sat at his table. God ate. God talked. God stayed. God showed up at the table.


The Fulfillment


"Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me." - Revelation 3:20


Jesus wants to eat with you. He wants to sit at your table. He wants to talk with you. He wants to stay. The tent meal was a picture. The table with Jesus is the reality. He shows up at the table.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like God is far away. You might feel like He is not interested in your daily life. But the tent meal tells a different story. God wants to sit at your table. He wants to be part of your ordinary life. He shows up at the table.


Faith Builder


Set aside a few minutes today to sit quietly with God. Imagine Him at your table. Talk to Him. Let Him be close.


The Prayer


Jesus, come to my table. Come and sit with me. I want you to be part of my everyday life. Stay with me. Eat with me. Be with me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 2: He Shows Up at Your Table

pages.subtitle: Free Sample Day (3 of 3)

pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD found Hagar near a spring in the desert... She gave this name to the LORD who spoke to her: 'You are the God who sees me.'" - Genesis 16:7, 13 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Hagar was a servant. She was running away. She was pregnant. She was alone. She was in the desert. And God showed up. He saw her. He spoke to her. He promised her a future. He showed up when she was alone.


The Fulfillment


"But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us." - Romans 5:8


The God who saw Hagar is the Christ who sees you. He shows up when you are alone. He sees you. He knows you. He comes to you.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel alone right now. You might feel like nobody sees you. You might feel like you are in the desert and no one knows. But the story of Hagar tells a different story. God sees you. He knows your name. He shows up when you are alone.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing that makes you feel alone. Then write this: "The God who sees me shows up when I am alone."


The Prayer


God, you see me. You see my desert. You see my pain. Thank you for showing up. Thank you for seeing me. I am not alone. Amen.
pages.title: Day 3: He Shows Up When You Are Alone

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"So Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him till daybreak... Then the man said, 'Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome.'" - Genesis 32:24, 28 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Jacob was alone. He was scared. He was about to face his brother who wanted to kill him. And a man came. And they wrestled. All night. And Jacob would not let go. The man was God. God showed up when he was scared.


The Fulfillment


"But we see Jesus, who was made lower than the angels for a little while, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death." - Hebrews 2:9


Jacob wrestled a man. The man was God. God let Himself be grabbed. God showed up when Jacob was scared. Jesus shows up when you are scared. He lets Himself be grabbed. He lets Himself be held.


Why It Matters For You


You might be scared right now. You might be facing something that feels too big. But the story of Jacob tells a different story. God shows up when you are scared. He is not scared of your fear. He is not scared of your struggle. He shows up.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you are scared of right now. Then write this: "God shows up when I am scared. I can hold on to Him."


The Prayer


God, I am scared. I am holding on to you. I am not letting go. Show up for me. Be with me. You are worth holding. Amen.
pages.title: Day 4: He Shows Up When You Are Scared

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Look! I see four men walking around in the fire, unbound and unharmed, and the fourth looks like a son of the gods." - Daniel 3:25 (Written around 530 B.C.)


Three men refused to bow to a golden statue. The king threw them into a furnace. It was so hot it killed the guards. But the king looked in and saw four men. Walking. In the fire. The fourth looked like a god. God showed up when they were in the fire.


The Fulfillment


"And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us. Not to keep us out of the fire. To be in it. The fourth man in the fire is a picture of Jesus. He shows up in the fire.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a fire right now. A trial. A hard season. A loss. But the story of the furnace tells a different story. God shows up in the fire. You are not alone. There is a fourth man. He is walking with you.


Faith Builder


Write down the fire you are in right now. Then write this: "God shows up in the fire. I am not alone."


The Prayer


Jesus, you show up in the fire. Thank you for walking with me. Thank you for staying. I am not alone. I am not afraid. You are here. Amen.
pages.title: Day 5: He Shows Up When You Are in the Fire

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the LORD spoke to Job out of the storm." - Job 38:1 (Written around 2000 B.C.)


Job lost everything. He was in pain. He asked God questions. And God showed up. Not in a soft voice. In a whirlwind. God showed up when Job asked.


The Fulfillment


"Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you." - Matthew 7:7


Jesus said to ask. To seek. To knock. God shows up when you ask. He is not scared of your questions. He is not scared of your pain. He shows up.


Why It Matters For You


You might have questions for God. You might have pain. You might have anger. But the story of Job tells a different story. God shows up when you ask. He is not scared of your questions. He wants to speak to you. He wants to show up.


Faith Builder


Write down one question you have for God. Do not be afraid to ask it. Then sit quietly and let Him be near.


The Prayer


God, I have questions. I have pain. I have anger. I am asking. Show up. Not with easy answers. With yourself. I need you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 6: He Shows Up When You Ask

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"'Neither,' he replied, 'but as commander of the army of the LORD I have now come.' Then Joshua fell facedown to the ground in reverence." - Joshua 5:14 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Joshua was about to fight a huge battle. He looked up and saw a man. The man had a sword drawn. It was the commander of the army of the Lord. God showed up before the battle.


The Fulfillment


"Then Jesus came to them and said, 'All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.'" - Matthew 28:18


The commander of the Lord's army has all authority. Jesus has all authority. He shows up before the battle. He shows up with a sword.


Why It Matters For You


You might be facing a battle right now. But the story of Joshua tells a different story. God shows up before the battle. He is the commander. He is the leader. He shows up with a sword.


Faith Builder


What battle are you facing today? Write it down. Then write this: "The commander of the Lord's army shows up before the battle."


The Prayer


Jesus, you show up before the battle. You are the commander. Lead me. Fight for me. The battle is yours. Amen.
pages.title: Day 7: He Shows Up with a Sword

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Mount Sinai was covered with smoke, because the LORD descended on it in fire. The smoke billowed up from it like smoke from a furnace, and the whole mountain trembled violently." - Exodus 19:18 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The people were at the bottom of the mountain. The mountain was on fire. Smoke was rising. The ground was shaking. A voice was speaking. God showed up on the mountain.


The Fulfillment


"For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire... But you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God." - Hebrews 12:18, 22


The mountain was terrifying. But we have not come to that mountain. We have come to a better one. Jesus opened a different way. God shows up on the mountain. He brings us close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like God is a mountain you cannot climb. But the story of the mountain tells a different story. God shows up on the mountain. He brings you up. You do not have to stand far away anymore. He shows up.


Faith Builder


Write down one way you feel far from God. Then write this: "God shows up on the mountain. He brings me close."


The Prayer


God, you show up on the mountain. Thank you that Jesus makes a way. Bring me close. Let me come up. Amen.
pages.title: Day 8: He Shows Up on the Mountain

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"After the earthquake came a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a gentle whisper." - 1 Kings 19:12 (Written around 900 B.C.)


Elijah was scared. He was depressed. He wanted to die. And God showed up. Not in the wind. Not in the earthquake. Not in the fire. In a gentle whisper. God showed up in the whisper.


The Fulfillment


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


God showed up in a whisper. Then He showed up in a baby. He shows up in the quiet. He shows up in the small. He shows up in the person.


Why It Matters For You


You might be looking for God in the big things. But He shows up in the quiet. He shows up in the whisper. He shows up in the small. He is speaking. Be still. Hear Him.


Faith Builder


Find a quiet place today. No music. No phone. Just you and God. Sit for five minutes in the silence. Listen.


The Prayer


God, help me to hear the whisper. You show up in the quiet. Speak to me in the silence. I am listening. Amen.
pages.title: Day 9: He Shows Up in the Whisper

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle. Moses could not enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle." - Exodus 40:34-35 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The cloud came down. It covered the tent. The glory filled the tabernacle. Moses could not even go in. God showed up in the cloud. God showed up in the glory. God showed up.


The Fulfillment


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


The glory cloud came down on a tent. Jesus came down in flesh. He is the new tent. He is the new cloud. He shows up in the glory. He shows up in the person.


Why It Matters For You


You might want to experience God's presence. You might feel like you are outside the tent, looking in. But the story of the cloud tells a different story. God shows up. He fills. He comes near. He shows up for you.


Faith Builder


Set aside a few quiet minutes today. Ask God to fill you with His presence. Then sit still and let Him be near.


The Prayer


God, show up in my life. Fill me with your presence. I want to know your glory. Fill me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 10: He Shows Up in the Cloud

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him... When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, it turned off the road into a field." - Numbers 22:22-23 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Balaam was on his way to curse God's people. The angel of the Lord stood in the road. With a sword. The donkey saw Him. The donkey turned. God showed up in the road.


The Fulfillment


"While they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross." - Matthew 27:32


On the way to the cross, another man was pulled in. Simon of Cyrene carried the cross. God showed up in the road. Jesus showed up in the road. He stood in our place.


Why It Matters For You


You might be on a road right now that you should not be on. And God might be standing in it. Sometimes the thing that stops you is the thing that saves you. God shows up in the road.


Faith Builder


Is there a road you are on right now that you know you should not be on? Write it down. Ask God to help you turn around.


The Prayer


God, thank you for showing up in my road. Thank you for the warnings. Help me to see. Help me to listen. I will turn. Amen.
pages.title: Day 11: He Shows Up in the Road

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the LORD spoke to Job out of the storm." - Job 38:1 (Written around 2000 B.C.)


Job lost everything. He was in pain. He asked God questions. And God showed up. In the storm. In the whirlwind. God showed up in the storm.


The Fulfillment


"He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down and it was completely calm." - Mark 4:39


Jesus spoke to a storm. He calmed the wind. He calmed the waves. God shows up in the storm. He speaks. He calms. He shows up.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a storm right now. You might feel like the waves are too high. But the story of Job tells a different story. God shows up in the storm. He speaks. He calms. He shows up.


Faith Builder


Write down the storm you are in right now. Then write this: "God shows up in the storm. He speaks. He calms."


The Prayer


God, I am in a storm. Show up. Speak. Calm. I need you. You show up in the storm. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 12: He Shows Up in the Storm

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah... and said, 'The LORD is with you, mighty warrior.'" - Judges 6:11-12 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


Gideon was hiding. He was scared. He was the least important person in his family. And God showed up. He called him a mighty warrior. God shows up when you are weak.


The Fulfillment


"But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong." - 1 Corinthians 1:27


God chooses the weak. He chose Gideon. He shows up when you are weak. He calls you a warrior.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel weak right now. You might feel like the least. But the story of Gideon tells a different story. God shows up when you are weak. He calls you a warrior. He shows up.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you feel too weak for. Then write this next to it: "God shows up when I am weak. He calls me a mighty warrior."


The Prayer


God, I feel weak. I feel like the least. But you show up when I am weak. You call me a mighty warrior. Make me brave. Amen.
pages.title: Day 13: He Shows Up When You Are Weak

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD appeared to her and said, 'You are barren and childless, but you are going to become pregnant and give birth to a son.'" - Judges 13:3 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


A woman could not have children. She was barren. And God showed up. He told her she would have a son. God shows up when you are barren.


The Fulfillment


"But the angel said to her, 'Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God. You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him Jesus.'" - Luke 1:30-31


The angel came to Mary. He promised a son. The son was Jesus. God shows up when you are barren. He gives the impossible.


Why It Matters For You


You might have a barren place. A place where nothing grows. But the story of the barren woman tells a different story. God shows up when you are barren. He gives the impossible. He gives a future.


Faith Builder


Write down your barren place. Then write this: "God shows up when I am barren. He gives the impossible."


The Prayer


God, I have a barren place. A place where nothing grows. Show up. Give me the impossible. Give me a future. Amen.
pages.title: Day 14: He Shows Up When You Are Barren

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"But the angel said to him, 'Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to call him John.'" - Luke 1:13 (Written around 5 B.C.)


Zechariah was a priest. He was old. They had no children. They had prayed for years. And God showed up. He told him his prayer had been heard. God shows up when you pray.


The Fulfillment


"And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for him." - Luke 1:76


John was the forerunner. He prepared the way. God showed up when Zechariah prayed. He hears. He answers. He shows up.


Why It Matters For You


You might have given up on a prayer. But the story of Zechariah tells a different story. God shows up when you pray. He hears. He answers. He shows up.


Faith Builder


Write down one prayer you have given up on. Then pray it again today. Just once. Say it out loud.


The Prayer


God, I have given up on some prayers. But you show up when I pray. You hear. You answer. Thank you. I am praying again. Amen.
pages.title: Day 15: He Shows Up When You Pray

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"He said, 'Look, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they are not hurt, and the appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods.'" - Daniel 3:25 (Written around 530 B.C.)


Three men were thrown into a furnace. The king looked in and saw four men. Walking. In the fire. The fourth looked like a god. God showed up in the fire.


The Fulfillment


"I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us always. The fourth man in the fire is a picture of Jesus. He shows up in the fire.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a fire right now. But the story of the furnace tells a different story. God shows up in the fire. You are not alone. There is a fourth man. He is walking with you.


Faith Builder


Write down the fire you are in today. Then write this: "God shows up in the fire. I am not alone."


The Prayer


Jesus, you show up in the fire. Thank you for walking with me. Thank you for staying. I am not alone. Amen.
pages.title: Day 16: He Shows Up in the Fire

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"But after he had considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, 'Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife, because what is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.'" - Matthew 1:20 (Written around 5 B.C.)


Joseph was confused. He was scared. He was unsure. And God showed up. In a dream. He spoke. He calmed. God shows up when you are confused.


The Fulfillment


"She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins." - Matthew 1:21


The name is Jesus. He saves. God showed up to Joseph. He shows up to you. He speaks. He calms. He saves.


Why It Matters For You


You might be confused right now. You might be scared. You might be unsure. But the story of Joseph tells a different story. God shows up when you are confused. He speaks. He guides. He calms.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you are confused about right now. Then write this: "God shows up when I am confused. He will guide me."


The Prayer


God, I am confused. I am scared. I am unsure. Show up. Speak. Guide me. Calm me. You show up when I am confused. Amen.
pages.title: Day 17: He Shows Up When You Are Confused

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"But the angel said to them, 'Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people. Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord.'" - Luke 2:10-11 (Written around 5 B.C.)


Shepherds were in the fields. The lowest of the low. The ones nobody noticed. And God showed up. He brought them good news. God shows up when you are overlooked.


The Fulfillment


"Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord." - Luke 2:11


The Savior is born. The Messiah is here. God showed up to the shepherds. He shows up to you. He shows up when you are overlooked.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel overlooked. You might feel forgotten. But the story of the shepherds tells a different story. God shows up when you are overlooked. He comes to you. You are not forgotten.


Faith Builder


Write down one way you feel overlooked. Then write this: "God shows up when I am overlooked. He comes to me."


The Prayer


God, I feel overlooked. I feel forgotten. But you show up when I am overlooked. Thank you for coming to me. I am not forgotten. Amen.
pages.title: Day 18: He Shows Up When You Are Overlooked

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Now the LORD provided a huge fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights." - Jonah 1:17 (Written around 780 B.C.)


Jonah ran from God. He got on a boat. A storm came. He was thrown into the sea. A fish swallowed him. For three days and three nights, he was in the belly of the fish. In the dark. In the deep. And God showed up.


The Fulfillment


"For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a huge fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth." - Matthew 12:40


Jesus said the fish was Him. He said the belly was the grave. He said the three days was His death. And on the third day, He came out. God shows up in the dark. God shows up in the grave. God shows up.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in the dark right now. You might feel like you are in the belly of a fish. But the story of Jonah tells a different story. God shows up in the dark. He hears. He answers. He brings you out. He shows up.


Faith Builder


Write down the dark place you are in right now. Then write this: "God shows up in the dark. He brings me out."


The Prayer


God, I am in the dark. I am in the deep. Show up. Hear me. Answer me. Bring me out. You show up in the dark. Amen.
pages.title: Day 19: He Shows Up When You Are in the Dark

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD came back a second time and touched him and said, 'Get up and eat, for the journey is too much for you.'" - 1 Kings 19:7 (Written around 900 B.C.)


Elijah was exhausted. He was in the wilderness. He wanted to die. And God showed up. He touched him. He fed him. He told him to get up. God shows up when you are exhausted.


The Fulfillment


"Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest." - Matthew 11:28


Jesus gives rest. He strengthens. He feeds. God shows up when you are exhausted. He gives you rest.


Why It Matters For You


You might be exhausted right now. You might feel like the journey is too much. But the story of Elijah tells a different story. God shows up when you are exhausted. He touches you. He feeds you. He lifts you up.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing that is exhausting you right now. Then write this: "God shows up when I am exhausted. He gives me rest."


The Prayer


God, I am exhausted. I am tired. The journey is too much. Show up. Touch me. Feed me. Lift me up. Give me rest. Amen.
pages.title: Day 20: He Shows Up When You Are Exhausted

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the LORD said to Moses, 'See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.'" - Exodus 23:20 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God sent an angel to guard His people. To lead them. To protect them. God shows up when you are in prison. He opens doors. He breaks chains.


The Fulfillment


"Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up. 'Quick, get up!' he said, and the chains fell off Peter's wrists." - Acts 12:7


An angel appeared to Peter. Chains fell off. The gates opened. Peter was free. God shows up when you are in prison. He opens doors. He breaks chains. He sets you free.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a prison right now. A prison of fear. Of addiction. Of guilt. Of shame. But the story of Peter tells a different story. God shows up when you are in prison. He opens doors. He breaks chains. He sets you free.


Faith Builder


Write down the prison you feel trapped in right now. Then write this: "God shows up when I am in prison. He opens doors. He breaks chains."


The Prayer


God, I am in a prison. Show up. Set me free. Break the chains. Open the door. Let me walk out. Amen.
pages.title: Day 21: He Shows Up When You Are in Prison

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord, high and exalted, seated on a throne; and the train of his robe filled the temple." - Isaiah 6:1 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah was in the temple. And he saw something. He saw the Lord. High and lifted up. On a throne. God showed up on the throne.


The Fulfillment


"Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus' glory and spoke about him." - John 12:41


Isaiah saw Jesus. He saw His glory. He saw His throne. God shows up on the throne. He is in control. He is the King.


Why It Matters For You


You might need to see God. You might need to see His glory. Look at Jesus. He is on the throne. He shows up on the throne. He is in control. He is the King. He shows up.


Faith Builder


Take a few minutes today to worship. Say out loud, "Holy, holy, holy. You are on the throne."


The Prayer


Lord, I see you. High and lifted up. Holy. On the throne. You show up on the throne. I worship you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 22: He Shows Up on the Throne

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them." - Psalm 34:7 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear Him. He camps around them. He protects them. He delivers them. God shows up when you need protection.


The Fulfillment


"For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways." - Psalm 91:11


God sends angels to guard His people. God shows up when you need protection. He guards you. He protects you. He delivers you.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel unprotected. You might feel vulnerable. But the psalm tells a different story. God shows up when you need protection. He encamps around you. He guards you. He delivers you.


Faith Builder


Say this out loud today: "The Angel of the Lord encamps around me. He protects me. God shows up when I need protection."


The Prayer


God, thank you for protecting me. Thank you for guarding me. Thank you for delivering me. You show up when I need protection. Amen.
pages.title: Day 23: He Shows Up When You Need Protection

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the LORD spoke to Job out of the storm." - Job 38:1 (Written around 2000 B.C.)


Job lost everything. He was in pain. He asked God questions. And God showed up. In the storm. God shows up in the storm.


The Fulfillment


"He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down and it was completely calm." - Mark 4:39


Jesus spoke to a storm. He calmed the wind. He calmed the waves. God shows up in the storm. He speaks. He calms.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a storm right now. You might feel like the waves are too high. But the story of Job tells a different story. God shows up in the storm. He speaks. He calms. He shows up.


Faith Builder


Write down the storm you are in right now. Then write this: "God shows up in the storm. He speaks. He calms."


The Prayer


God, I am in a storm. Show up. Speak. Calm. I need
…..
CONTINUED — DAY 24 (FINISHED)


The Prayer (continued)


God, I am in a storm. Show up. Speak. Calm. I need you. You show up in the storm. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 24: He Shows Up When You Are in the Storm

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to keep it from the Midianites." - Judges 6:11 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


Gideon was grieving. His people were oppressed. He was hiding. He was afraid. And God showed up. He sat down under the oak. He spoke to him. He called him a mighty warrior. God shows up when you are grieving.


The Fulfillment


"He is the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our troubles." - 2 Corinthians 1:3-4


God is the Father of compassion. He comforts. He shows up when you are grieving. He sits with you. He speaks to you. He comforts you.


Why It Matters For You


You might be grieving right now. You might have lost something. You might have lost someone. But the story of Gideon tells a different story. God shows up when you are grieving. He sits with you. He speaks to you. He comforts you.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you are grieving right now. Then write this: "God shows up when I am grieving. He comforts me."


The Prayer


God, I am grieving. I am hurting. Show up. Sit with me. Comfort me. You are the Father of compassion. I need your comfort. Amen.
pages.title: Day 25: He Shows Up When You Are Grieving

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the LORD God said, 'It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.'" - Genesis 2:18 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God saw that Adam was alone. And He said it was not good. He made a helper for him. God cares about loneliness. He shows up when you are lonely.


The Fulfillment


"And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us always. He shows up when you are lonely. He is with you. He is not far. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might be lonely right now. You might feel isolated. But the story of Adam tells a different story. God cares about loneliness. He shows up when you are lonely. He is with you. You are not alone.


Faith Builder


Write down one way you feel lonely right now. Then write this: "God shows up when I am lonely. He is with me."


The Prayer


God, I am lonely. I feel isolated. Show up. Be with me. You promised to be with me always. I am not alone. Amen.
pages.title: Day 26: He Shows Up When You Are Lonely

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD answered, 'Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding.'" - Judges 13:18 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


Manoah asked the angel his name. The angel said it was beyond understanding. God showed up. He answered. Even when Manoah could not understand. God shows up when you are doubting.


The Fulfillment


"Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed." - John 20:29


Jesus said this to Thomas. Thomas doubted. Jesus showed up. He did not scold Thomas. He showed him His hands. He showed him His side. Jesus shows up when you are doubting.


Why It Matters For You


You might be doubting right now. You might have questions you cannot answer. But the story of Manoah tells a different story. God shows up when you are doubting. He does not scold you. He shows you Himself. He shows up.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you doubt. Then write this: "God shows up when I doubt. He shows me Himself."


The Prayer


God, I am doubting. I have questions. But you show up when I doubt. You do not scold me. You show me yourself. Thank you. Help my unbelief. Amen.
pages.title: Day 27: He Shows Up When You Are Doubting

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Moses said to the LORD, 'I cannot carry all these people by myself; the burden is too heavy for me.'" - Numbers 11:14 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Moses was tired. The burden was too heavy. And God showed up. He helped him. He gave him a helper. He lifted the burden. God shows up when you are tired.


The Fulfillment


"Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls." - Matthew 11:28-29


Jesus gives rest. He lifts the burden. He gives you a helper. God shows up when you are tired. He gives you rest.


Why It Matters For You


You might be tired right now. The burden might be too heavy. But the story of Moses tells a different story. God shows up when you are tired. He helps you. He lifts the burden. He gives you rest.


Faith Builder


Write down the burden that feels too heavy right now. Then write this: "God shows up when I am tired. He lifts the burden."


The Prayer


God, I am tired. The burden is too heavy. Show up. Help me. Lift the burden. Give me rest. You show up when I am tired. Amen.
pages.title: Day 28: He Shows Up When You Are Tired

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink." - Genesis 21:19 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Hagar was hopeless. She was dying. Her son was dying. She cried. She gave up. And God showed up. He opened her eyes. He showed her a well. He gave her water. God shows up when you are hopeless.


The Fulfillment


"Whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life." - John 4:14


Jesus is the water. He is the well. He is the spring. God shows up when you are hopeless. He opens your eyes. He gives you water. He gives you life.


Why It Matters For You


You might be hopeless right now. You might feel like giving up. But the story of Hagar tells a different story. God shows up when you are hopeless. He opens your eyes. He gives you water. He gives you life.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing that makes you feel hopeless. Then write this: "God shows up when I am hopeless. He opens my eyes."


The Prayer


God, I am hopeless. I feel like giving up. Show up. Open my eyes. Give me water. Give me life. You show up when I am hopeless. Amen.
pages.title: Day 29: He Shows Up When You Are Hopeless

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace." - Isaiah 9:6 (Written around 700 B.C.)


A child. A son. Mighty God. Everlasting Father. Prince of Peace. This is the promise. This is the appearance. This is the one who came close. The child is God. The son is eternal. The baby is the Creator. This is the one who shows up. Always. In every season. In every story. In every need.


The Fulfillment


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


The Word became flesh. The appearance became a person. The shadow became substance. The picture became reality. The bush became a body. The fire became a friend. The whisper became a brother. The star became the King. The tomb became the risen Lord. The ultimate appearance is Jesus. And He is here. He shows up. Always.


Why It Matters For You


You have been learning about the God who shows up for 30 days. But here is the beautiful truth. It is not just history. It is your story too. The God who walked in the garden wants to walk with you. The God who sat at the table wants to sit at your table. The God who was in the fire wants to be in your fire. The God who showed up for them wants to show up for you. He is not far. He shows up. Always. In every season. In every need. He is with you right now.


Faith Builder


Take a moment today to thank God for showing up. Write down one way you have seen Him show up during this 30 day journey.


The Prayer


Jesus, thank you for showing up. Thank you for the garden. Thank you for the tent. Thank you for the fire. Thank you for the whisper. Thank you for the storm. Thank you for the throne. Thank you for the tomb. Thank you for being the God who shows up. I receive you. I trust you. And I know you show up. Amen.



END MATTER


The 30-Day Comfort Challenge


You have journeyed through 30 moments where God showed up. Now what? I challenge you to read the Psalms. Pick one psalm a day for 30 days. The Psalms are full of people who needed God to show up. They cried out. They waited. They trusted. And God showed up. As you read, look for the moments where God shows up. Look for the comfort. Look for the hope. And then ask yourself, "Do I know that God shows up for me?" He does. He is not far. He is with you.


A Note on Faith


The appearances are evidence. They are evidence of a God who shows up. They are evidence of a God who is not distant. They are evidence of a God who cares. But evidence does not save you. The appearances point to a person. The appearances point to Jesus. You can study the appearances and still miss the one who appears. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The appearances are on the table. The door is open. It is your choice. He shows up. Will you open?


About the Author


Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the hidden wisdom of the Bible. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.


Coming Next: The Secret Visitor


If you enjoyed this journey, the next book in the series goes deeper. The Secret Visitor takes a 30 day look at how God was always with His people and why that matters to you. It is for the new believer who wants to go further.
